content: High-density EEG data were recorded at a sampling rate of 500 Hz with a bandpass of 0.1 to 100 Hz, using a 128-channel EEG Geodesic Hydrocel system (Electrical Geodesics). The recording reference was set at electrode Cz. The head circumference of each participant was measured to select an appropriately sized EEG net. To ensure good contact, the impedance of each electrode was checked prior to recording, and was kept below 40 kOhm. Electrode impedance levels were checked after every third block of 50 sentences (approx. every 30 mins) and reduced if necessary.
